body:
Greetings, all … in my book  We Make the Road by Walking , you’ll find 52+ chapters that can be read aloud in 10-15 minutes or so. Churches around the world have used it as an alternative lectionary and curriculum for a year.

 Since all of us are staying home to protect ourselves and each other fro COVID-19, I wanted to offer this reading of the chapters for Holy Week. I welcome anyone to use these in any way that is helpful – for personal use, for streaming to your group or faith community, etc. Stay safe, stay healthy, and stay focused on love for God, self, others, and this beautiful earth.
